steady_pace.description: Moderate English pace (about 110-130 WPM per window), one hesitation, three completed sentence pauses, and one partial misrecognition corrected by its final.

final_transcript: Practicing a presentation alone has one fundamental problem for every speaker.
There is no audience to tell you how it lands.
LeCoach gives you a private audience that reacts while you speak.
Everything runs locally, so your rehearsal never leaves the device.
Um, the avatars lean in when your pace is steady and clear.
Afterwards, it shows the few moments that mattered most.

rapid_speech.description: Pace rises from about 110 to above 200 WPM with only short gaps, so no completed pauses.

final_transcript: Today I want to show you how LeCoach works.
We capture your voice and camera, and the audience reacts right away.
The speech pipeline transcribes locally, measures your pace, counts fillers, and tracks pauses.
The vision pipeline estimates facing direction and movement, then the engagement engine combines everything.
When you rush through the key result, the audience gets confused and starts drifting away.
Then you see exactly where it happened, why it happened, and what to try next time.
All of it runs on your own machine with no cloud service involved.

filler_heavy.description: Repeated hesitations and set-off discourse markers: 11 fillers in 37 words, about 24-29 fillers per minute.

final_transcript: Um, so, uh, today I want to, um, talk about our results.
The model, you know, it basically, uh, listens to the microphone.
And then, like, the audience, um, reacts, I mean, it changes faces.
Uh, so, um, that is basically how it, uh, works.

prolonged_silence.description: A 10.8 s silence with working capture: the pause is reported active as it grows, completed once speech resumes, and WPM is a measured 0 rather than null.

final_transcript: Let me walk you through the three steps of a rehearsal.
First, you start a session and the audience appears.
Sorry, I lost my place for a moment there.
Second, you speak while the avatars react in real time.

delivery_effects.description: Producer delivery effects: model warm-up delays the first final so one window reports null coverage, a stale partial arrives after its final, a final is retried identically, a hallucinated partial is retracted by an empty final, pause metrics arrive out of order, and a final drains after session.stopping.

final_transcript: This is the part that matters most.
We slow down and pause before the key number.

microphone_denied.description: Microphone permission is denied at start: a speech signal.status and unavailable metrics with null values, never a measured zero.

microphone_lost.description: The microphone disconnects mid-utterance: the cut utterance is finalized at the disconnect time and later windows report an error with null values.

final_transcript: We are about to see the audience react.
Watch what happens when I speed up a little.

silence_only.description: Capture works but the speaker never starts: measured 0 WPM and 0 fillers, and no pause because pauses are only measured after the first speech.

unsupported_language.description: Mandarin speech outside the v0 English rules: transcripts and pauses are reported, while WPM and filler fields stay null.

final_transcript: 大家好，今天我想介紹 LeCoach。
它會在你練習的時候即時給你反應。
所有資料都留在你的電腦上。

repeated_sessions.description: Two sessions reuse zero-based clocks, event IDs, and utterance IDs; each is checked and reconstructed separately.
